popCulture.title: Picus
popCulture.description: The Ausonian king Circe turned into a woodpecker — Canens wasting into air, Ovid's Italian metamorphosis of love refused.

popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Book 14 — Picus, Canens, and Circe's revenge among the Latin woods that will become Rome's mythic landscape.
